backend: GDK Wayland, Weston 15 nested X11 host, no XWayland
input: The isolated Weston forwarded pointer and keyboard events to native Wayland surfaces. DISPLAY was absent in the app; trace included xdg_wm_base, wl_pointer and wl_keyboard. Document selection used real pointer events in the viewport, and the GTK chooser opened both times.
checked: Each owned story used the properties panel to resize, undo and redo, with a single synchronized publication. Independent OPC comparison verified both extents in each story and all unrelated XML, relationships and media. The app reselected each picture at the correct size after reopening.
